statusDefinitions.visible-uncensused: kind has visible examples, but a complete object count was not established
statusDefinitions.not-visible-in-selected-area: no clearly identifiable object of this kind in the selected area of this photo; not a claim of game-wide absence
statusDefinitions.not-assessable: photo distance, overlap or area ambiguity prevents reliable kind-level determination
statusDefinitions.no-area-pinned-photo: this definition area is not the selected model input; additional area-specific photo required
statusDefinitions.sparse-sample-only: frozen reference has one or more values for samples only; not a complete property denominator
statusDefinitions.not-fully-assessed: no complete value census; null does not mean absent
statusDefinitions.visibleObjectCountLowerBound: conservative visible minimum for the selected area; a sparse lower bound, never the full denominator
statusDefinitions.visibleObjectCountUpperBound: null unless absence in selected area is clear; no total object count is inferred
statusDefinitions.visible-exact-count: selected-area photo shows one unambiguous physical item of this kind; count is a narrow visible-photo count, not game-wide state
